# LangGraph

> Build stateful, agentic applications with LangGraph and LangSmith

LangGraph is a low-level orchestration framework and runtime for building long-running, stateful agents with durable execution, streaming, human-in-the-loop control, and graph-based workflows.

## Start Here

- [LangGraph overview](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/javascript/langgraph)
- [Install LangGraph](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/javascript/langgraph/install)
- [Quickstart](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/javascript/langgraph/quickstart)
- [Choosing between Graph and Functional APIs](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/javascript/langgraph/choosing-apis)
- [Workflows and agents](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/javascript/langgraph/workflows-agents)
